🎥🎬: IT Chapter Two (2019)

Twenty-seven years after defeating Pennywise, the Losers’ Club has grown up and gone their separate ways. When a series of disturbing events begins happening again in Derry, Mike Hanlon realizes that the creature they thought they destroyed has returned.

Mike calls Bill, Beverly, Richie, Ben, Eddie, and Stanley back to Derry, forcing them to confront the childhood fears they tried to leave behind. As Pennywise manipulates their memories and uses their deepest fears against them, the group must rediscover the bond that helped them survive as children.

With Pennywise growing stronger, the Losers return to the places where their nightmare began for one final confrontation. To defeat him for good, they must face their trauma, overcome their fears, and stand together one last time.

source_details.synopsis: It Chapter Two is a 2019 American supernatural horror film directed by Andy Muschietti from a screenplay by Gary Dauberman. It is the sequel to It (2017) and the second of a two-part adaptation of the 1986 novel It by Stephen King. The film stars James McAvoy, Jessica Chastain, Bill Hader, Isaiah Mustafa, Jay Ryan, James Ransone, Andy Bean, and Bill Skarsgård as Pennywise the Dancing Clown. Set 27 years after the events of the first film, the story centers on the Losers Club and their relationships as they reunite to destroy It once and for all.
